wf_demo_hackathon_nvidia.title: Competitive Evaluation: AI Workflow Automation Platforms for SMBs
wf_demo_hackathon_nvidia.objective: Research five AI workflow automation platforms suitable for small businesses. Compare documented features, integrations, pricing where available, strengths, limitations, and suitability. Recommend the three best options and produce an evidence-based decision report.
wf_demo_hackathon_nvidia.context: Nebius x NVIDIA AI Hackathon demonstration benchmark. Target audience is small business owners and technical leads seeking sustainable ROI.
wf_demo_hackathon_nvidia.constraints: Verify pricing against documented 2026 tiers; separate verified findings from assumptions.

tasks.title: Query & Discover Top Small Business Workflow Platforms
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive web searches for top AI workflow and automation platforms suitable for SMBs in 2026.

input.query: best AI workflow automation platforms for small business 2026 Zapier Make n8n Relay.app Lindy

verificationResult.criteria: At least 5 distinct platforms identified with documented URLs and feature sets
verificationResult.notes: 5 commercial/open-core platforms retrieved with current documentation links.

tasks.title: Extract Technical Specifications & Integrations Matrix
tasks.description: Analyze API capabilities, native app connectors, webhook support, and AI model orchestration for each platform.

verificationResult.criteria: Technical capability matrix populated for all 5 subjects with verification
verificationResult.notes: All 5 platforms evaluated across 4 technical axes.

tasks.title: Analyze Pricing Tiers & Cost-Per-Operation Modeling
tasks.description: Calculate monthly cost curves across 1,000 to 50,000 monthly automated operations.

output.cheapestScaleOption: Make.com for volume; n8n for unlimited self-hosted workloads

verificationResult.criteria: Mathematical verification of cost curves based on published 2026 tier formulas
verificationResult.notes: Precision arithmetic verified with unit constraints.

tasks.title: Synthesize Recommendations & Rank Top 3 Candidates
tasks.description: Weight features, cost, developer ergonomics, and reliability to select and recommend the 3 best tools.

topThreeRecommendations.rationale: Unbeatable visual debugging, rich branching, and highest ops per dollar.
Exceptional for developer teams requiring code execution, LangChain agent loops, and data privacy.
Largest catalog of 6,000+ connectors and lowest barrier to entry for non-technical teams.

verificationResult.criteria: Explicit weighted decision rubric satisfied with sourced pros/cons
verificationResult.notes: Ranking verified with weighted multi-factor scoring.

tasks.title: Generate Comprehensive 10-Section Decision Report
tasks.description: Compile evidence-based decision report with executive summary, methodology, source links, and limitations.

verificationResult.criteria: Full report structure complying with hackathon standard
